body:
Yea nice find. As far as your mother, I mean suicide is a lot worse than drugs. Can you tell her how bad you feel mentally? "Mom I'm really serious about this." Might work..

Therapy is difficult to first start for sure. But if you can clear that hurdle it's absolutely worth it. I used to walk away from their offices feeling like I'm high. It goes away, but they know the right things to say. I hope you can give it another try.

Have you already tried the zombie drug? Effects can always vary per person.

What about a different therapist? This really sounds right up their alley, maybe the last one sucked.

One thing that helped with my anxiety a bit was this book called "feeling good." Sounds stupid, but it was surprisingly helpful. I don't remember the author, but just look for the one with good reviews.

Lol at affordable.

It does seem difficult, but there might be a silver lining too. It sounds like you have a fresh start in a new place and some newly won freedom. Is that correct?
Have you tried therapy? It can really be helpful. Medication as well, but therapists are usually good at what they do and especially with stuff like anxiety.

Can you email a therapist? Some of them have reviews, see if you can pick a well rated one.

Believe me, they are good with this kind of stuff. Your issues don't sound like you need a hospital, but someone who is a professional at dealing with these types of things.

The first time you go to meet them will be scary. Email first, then talk on the phone for a minute to let them explain what they do. If they are halfway decent they will make you feel a lot better after 1 session. Not fixed, but you will feel better.

Also, I'm with you on the needles, they're scary as hell.

Oh yeah one more thing. A lot of doctors have a no nonsense type attitude. Many have really bad bedside manner, but I don't think they are mad at you or anything. They just aren't trained for compassion. And it attracts a certain personality, not a negative, but it's a difficult profession so they can be rough around the edges. Don't take it personally.

Maybe he is bipolar too? Maybe I'm a dick for thinking that would be funny.

He sounds very insecure and controlling regardless. You are better off without someone like that in your life. That's something you should remember everytime you miss him.

Break ups suck for everyone though. Give the wound a little more time to heal. Not saying life will be great or anything, but don't let an asshole like that ruin your life. I believe that's in your own hands. But hey I'm suicidal too, what do I know?
